id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

purchaseOrderId.description:
A unique identifier of this purchase order. This should be used for display purposes in the UI.
**NOTE**: This is different {#id} of this purchase order, which is system generated.

supplier.description: Name of the supplier who will be fulfilling this purchase order.

orderLines.description: The different {@link PurchaseOrderLine} items which are part of this purchase order.

purchaseDate.description: The date and time when this purchase order was placed.

totalCost.description:
Amount of the purchase order.
This should be equal to sum of all #orderLines cost.

title:
A purchase order is an order placed from a buyer to a supplier requesting different quantity of items at different times.
One Purchase order consists of many purchase order lines, where each order line represents one item which is being ordered as part of this purchase order.
Each purchase order line holds information about how much quantity of an item was ordered and also when is it requested to be delivered. See {@link PurchaseOrderLine} for more details.
name: PurchaseOrder
